records.prompt:
Use the supplied original three-direction Starfall lettering reference. The user explicitly selected panel B CRYSTAL BURST as the dominant style, with a restrained contribution from panel C COMET SWEEP and a little of panel A's luminous warmth. Develop ONE COHERENT original bespoke game-display lettering family, approximately 70% B / 20% C / 10% warm pearl. These percentages describe visual influence, not separate fonts or pixel areas. Preserve B's recognizable broad carved crystal facets and angular yet friendly silhouettes. Add modest forward gesture, a sweeping initial OR a tapered terminal, never a giant calligraphic underline on every word. A little soft rounding, bright pearl glints, family-colored refracted planes and plum depth give warmth. This must look predominantly like B, NOT A with a few facets. Do not use generic rounded sans-serif, medieval blackletter, thin script, spiky metal lettering, casino candy, thick cartoon badges, banners, bubbles, coin motifs or multipliers. Keep wide-open counters, spelling clarity, crisp modest outlines, large calm facets rather than dense cracks, restrained glow. Letter interiors must retain substantial saturated family color; small pearl highlights, not all-white letters. Use title case and deliberate lively letter rhythms. Bright front/top planes, shallow dark violet/amethyst depth, luminous rims. At most 2-3 small celestial diamond glints per headline; never replace a letter, digit or punctuation with a star. All sheets are CONCEPT ART, not runtime screenshots, SVG paths, a font file, or verified mobile UI.

Create a polished PORTRAIT art-director's lettering-family specimen sheet, with five roomy horizontal rows on a very dark uniform midnight/plum background. Include subtle dividers and quiet small row numbers. No game scenery on this sheet: concentrate on readable letter artwork. A tiny editorial heading at the top says "STARFALL · CRYSTAL COMET". Footer exactly "LETTERING CONCEPTS · NOT IN-GAME CAPTURES".

Render these FIVE exact hero headlines, one per row, centered and generously spaced:
1. "Brilliant!" in warm amber/gold crystal.
2. "Constellation!" in luminous aqua crystal.
3. "Square!" in fresh mint crystal.
4. "Cross!" in rose crystal.
5. "Relay!" in violet crystal.

All five must visibly be THE SAME TYPOGRAPHIC FAMILY with consistent facet scale, weight, bevel depth, counters, modest forward rhythm and original crystal-sculpted forms. Make long Constellation! legible without crushing letter widths; it may be smaller than the short words but no arbitrary word splits or missing letters. Small quiet swatch/caption next to each row may identify the family color in plain restrained text. The "Brilliant!" and "Constellation!" shapes must retain strong resemblance to reference B, incorporating only a little reference C gesture.

This is a complete concept specimen, not five in-game events at once. Do not include +values, numbers, extra announcement words, character art, scores, buttons, phones, logos, gems with faces, panels, ribbons or halos enclosing the words. Distinct color examples do NOT assign permanent colors to achievements. Every word will eventually inherit harvest color. This sheet's goal is show all five beautifully crafted designs at a readable size. Balanced margins; no clipping of flourishes or glints.
referenceRoles: Original three-style sheet: panel B lead, panel C gesture, panel A warmth
